events.content: The product page currently awaits related products in its server render, so Next’s automatic link prefetch can fetch them as soon as the link enters view. I’m changing the featured link to disable that automatic prefetch and request the route on user intent (hover or keyboard focus), so the product data is warm by the time navigation starts.

events.content:
Automatic product-page prefetch is disabled on the featured link. Hovering or focusing it explicitly prefetches `/product`, warming the related products before navigation. The change is in [featured-product-link.tsx](/workspace/app/featured-product-link.tsx) and [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx).

I didn’t run tests or a build. `package.json` and `package-lock.json` also show workspace changes that I did not make.
